blocks.html: In this document, you’ll learn about the different methods in the Cache Module's service and how to use them.

blocks.title: Deprecation Notice
blocks.html: The Cache Module is deprecated starting from [Medusa v2.11.0](https://github.com/medusajs/medusa/releases/tag/v2.11.0). [Use the Caching Module](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/infrastructure-modules/caching) instead.
This method retrieves data from the cache.

types.name: key
types.description: The key of the item to retrieve.

types.name: Promise
types.description: The item that was stored in the cache. If the item was not found, null is returned.

blocks.html: This method removes an item from the cache.

types.name: key
types.description: The key of the item to remove.

types.name: Promise
types.description: This method removes an item from the cache.

blocks.html: This method stores data in the cache.

types.name: key
types.description: The key of the item to store.

types.name: data
types.description: The data to store in the cache.

types.name: ttl
types.description: The time-to-live (TTL) value in seconds. If not provided, the default TTL value is used. The default value is based on the used Cache Module.

types.name: Promise
types.description: This method stores data in the cache.
